_comment: PARTIAL. 'This enters the arena with a balance counter' is authored. 'At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this unless you remove a balance counter from it' is an unless-cost on a trigger, and 'If you would be dealt damage, prevent 1 of that damage' is a RECURRING prevention -- PREVENT_DAMAGE registers a one-shot replacement that is consumed, where this token prevents 1 from every instance while it survives. Both NEED NEW PRIMITIVES.
